description: Superseded closeout: measure-guard accepts a registry [x] for a plan with open task boxes when the plan has a "Superseded by <target>" line and metadata.json status "superseded". The shared core gains supersededTarget, the three adapters set supersededBy from the plan text and metadata.json, and the DSH metadata check skips the actual_tasks equality check for a superseded track (PM order, 2026-11-17)
